stage_1_intro.text: Welcome, traveler. Your journey begins here.

stage_1_left.text: You took the left path. It's quiet here.

stage_1_left_food.text: You bought some food. It might come in handy later.

stage_1_left_no_food.text: You decided not to buy food. You might regret this later.

stage_1_right.text: You took the right path. You hear strange noises.
